versions.title: Release 2026.11.18.1633 (build 13)
summary: 🐷 **MCP writes now speak up!** Agents can report when writes are **accepted or rejected**, so you get clearer feedback on what happened.
🚀 **New `search_quests` MCP tool added!** A fresh way to search quests right from the agent side — oinkcredible for discovery.
⏱️ **Write verification got a big reliability boost.** Paused write checks now resume properly, and Coda writes are confirmed within about a minute for a smoother sync experience.
🧾 **Release history is way more accurate now.** Same-version and same-day releases are now distinguished by **build number**, so the release notes stay tidy and correct.
🏷️ **Release versions now include tag time.** That means clearer version tracking and fewer “which build was that?” mysteries.

versions.title: Release 2026.11.17 (build 11)
summary: 🎉 You can now **open Claude Desktop directly with a prompt for a quest** — instant launch, less clicking, more doing.
🐷 The board got a **big glow-up**: you can **multi-select On Deck quests and defer them together**, plus see **agent chat links on cards** and open a shiny new **notes sheet** right from the board.
📝 **Quest notes are here!** Notes now work across **Things, Coda, Craft, and Linear**, with a proper notes model and managed section support so your piggy little notes stay organized.

🛠️ MCP just got much beefier: there’s now a **Settings → Agents pane**, a **tools-only MCP server**, **quest board tools**, and agents can run over a **user-only Unix socket with a stdio bridge**. Oink yeah.
🔧 Important fix: **in-flight MCP replies now still get delivered even after the client stops sending**, so conversations won’t get cut off mid-snort.
🧱 Craft support is more reliable now too: **single tasks are read via `GET blocks?id`**, and Craft notes are stored as **child blocks inside the task page** for better verification and syncing.

versions.title: Release 2026.04.25 (build 6)
summary: Added a light/dark/system appearance toggle and refreshed the macOS toolbar/board chrome for a more native look.
Improved section navigation and window titling: section labels now appear in the toolbar, with better jump-button visibility and off-screen section access.
Standardized floating pills and source/task controls, including consistent sizing, clearer labels, and better placement around the board.
Updated the board layout and visuals: refined lane spacing/alignment, softer lane tints, tinted glass lane containers, and new background image assets.
Fixed search and focus behavior, including more stable toolbar actions, no unwanted refocus after exiting search, and fewer async warnings.
Improved release/test automation: fixed single-worker test execution, removed a problematic parallel-testing setting, and added release checks/Discord notification requirements.
Added usability improvements for source links and Linear integration, including opening tickets in the Linear desktop app and always showing source links.
